name: Capture baseline and lock coordinate contract
description: Capture the current home reveal at authored cameras and document exact glass origin, monitor/desk placement, world scale, room bounds, and export axis conventions. Done when the Blender scene can round-trip without moving the live screen by a pixel.

name: Improve material authenticity
description: Replace generic procedural-noise look with scale-correct, correlated offline-safe material response where feasible.
result: Bundled local CC0 Poly Haven dark-wood and painted-plaster PBR sets with source/license README, then wired color/normal/roughness maps into Room.jsx. Runtime remains offline-safe.

name: Make the talk scenes photographic and repeatedly revealable
description:
## Goal
Raise the realtime scene from a good game render to a photographic, stage-ready sequence while preserving the cold-open trick and one-press/one-slide invariant.

## Scope
- Distinct reveal camera choreography
- Home office, cubicle, and ~50-agent monitor-wall stage variants
- Rebalanced lighting and restrained post
- Physically believable CRT glass and Trinitron aperture grille
- Better monitor manufacturing cues and tessellation
- Local/offline PBR material direction
- Build and screenshot verification

## Done when
All variants can be selected per slide, stage switches happen while the glass covers frame, current and new reveal beats build, and representative screenshots are reviewed.
result: Delivered photographic scene pass and repeated reveal system across home office, cubicle, and 55-monitor agent wall. Updated PLAN.md with landed architecture and decisions. Build, runtime screenshots, CAD export, and navigation invariant verified.

name: Compile reusable cue and transition presets
description: After current visuals stabilize, compile complete camera/CRT/phosphor/transition snapshots once, migrate smoothTime to transition.duration compatibly, and remove redundant visual inheritance.

name: Build the transition and image-quality evidence harness
description: Add checked-in production-build captures/traces for all slides and adjacent transitions: keydown, first motion, rAF/GPU timing, stage identity, programs/textures, shadows, uploads, settled hashes, supersampled AA references, and clearance/clay/light-only captures required by QUALITY.md.
result: Added dependency-free CDP harness and deterministic PNG comparator under scripts/quality/. Smoke run discovered 15 slides, captured settled frames/transition traces, wrote JSON/Markdown, and correctly failed the zero-allocation gate. Syntax checks and pnpm build pass. Production app observability seams remain explicit follow-up work.

name: Re-UV desk and rebalance photographic lighting
description:
Give desk top/edge/underside intentional mapping, remove black-on-black home prop loss, restore contact and tonal separation in the office, and pass neutral-clay/light-only diagnostics within texture budgets.

Progress 2026-08-26: desk has indexed top/edge/underside UV/material groups. Reusable stage look presets now own environment, motivated lights, exposure, bloom, vignette, and dither. Screen emission direction was corrected; broad aimed home/office returns replace punctual fill. Headed 1920 captures improved home reveal mean luma 6.5→13.2, profile housing 4.34→7.10, and foreground desk 11.36→31.36 without clipping; office troffers remain <200/255. Integrated run 57f0a533-b7fd-425e-a40d-25f9725d813a captured seven anchors with no console/network errors. Still open for projector approval and neutral-clay/light-only evidence.

name: Resolve second-pass CRT and mouse visual review
description: The user rejected the first CRT and mouse upgrades. Second pass replaces the CRT with a visibly asymmetric 20,424-triangle FW900-language housing/stand/control barrel while preserving the exact glass contract, and replaces the mouse with an original 6,356-triangle 130mm corded ergonomic wheel mouse. Production captures pass technically; keep open until the user approves the actual viewer/runtime pixels.
result: User explicitly approved the second-pass assets as MUCH better. CRT is now a 20,424-triangle FW900-language housing with preserved glass contract; mouse is a 6,356-triangle corded period ergonomic design. Both are integrated into production, GLB-valid, and captured at 1920x1080 through Swamp.

name: Make slide arrival deterministic and eliminate transition flashes
description: Fix path-dependent camera/stage/CRT/phosphor state so a refreshed deep link and a settled navigation produce the same frame. Preload all stage assets and shaders before the cold open. Remove stateful post effects likely causing white-square flashes during large depth/scene changes. Verify representative direct-vs-navigation screenshots and full forward/back navigation.
result: Deep links now install camera and CRT/phosphor state before first paint; navigated flights use bounded slide durations and snap camera/uniform targets exactly. Stage contexts remain mounted, shaders/materials are compile-warmed without hidden cube renders, and forward/back swaps are deterministic visibility changes. Distant agent clocks reset on stage entry. Removed N8AO, depth-of-field, chromatic aberration, HueSaturation, and async SMAA; replaced with a stable 2x MSAA composer plus restrained bloom/vignette/dither. Direct-vs-navigated state matched exactly for agent-wall and inside-glass. Captured 14 frames across wall/phosphor shifts with no console errors or white flashes. Full 0..14/13..0 navigation and production build pass.

name: Repair CRT, agent-screen, and phosphor aliasing
description:
Fix undefined reversed smoothsteps and screen-space Nyquist thresholds; add derivative AA/LOD to procedural agent screens; match phosphor geometry to the curved CRT surface and implement a true crossfade. Meet Q1 evidence bars.

Progress 2026-08-26: reversed smoothsteps removed; CRT and agent-screen derivative/Nyquist guards added; phosphor is monochrome, reconstructs a continuous curved handoff plane, then releases into a row-correlated curtain instead of RGB confetti/star scatter. Swamp shader-only vs geometry-only evidence passes luma MAE (1.54/255) and brightness change (3.35%) but still fails centroid (8.35px vs 0.25px), so this task remains open.
result: Removed reversed smoothsteps; added derivative/Nyquist filtering to CRT and procedural agent screens; made the phosphor field monochrome, curved, and row-correlated; and corrected shader/geometry compositing mathematically. Final deterministic 1920x1080 endpoint evidence: luma MAE 0.003031/255, centroid error 0.000700px, brightness change -0.000145%, SSIM 0.999965988. Swamp shader run 327a2207-b0ec-4736-bab5-357fb422a37d and geometry run 87d91647-a00b-46bf-b8e3-4812cf4bf9bc both built/captured successfully.

name: Integrate Blender home stage into R3F
description: Load the Blender-authored static home environment while retaining the existing live Monitor/CRTScreen, Props where appropriate, stage visibility, lighting intent, shadow lifecycle, and warmup. Do not change cold-open behavior or navigation semantics.

name: Catalog stages and validate slide snapshots
description: Add a finite stage catalog, use it as the warmup stage source, and validate slide IDs, stages, camera endpoints, and cold-open invariants at module initialization without changing visuals.
result: Added src/presentation/stages.js and defineSlides.js; slides now validate once at module load and presentationRuntime derives warmup stage IDs from the catalog. Added CONTEXT.md and PRESENTATION-SYSTEM.md and linked them from PLAN/CLAUDE.

name: Blender-authored cinematic home office
description:
## Goal
Replace the current box-built home environment with a genuinely photographic, lived-in contemporary home office authored in Blender, while preserving the talk's cold-open illusion, live CRT/session renderer, camera choreography, determinism, offline safety, and performance budget.

## Direction
A complete 3am room—not a 1990s CGI set, furniture showroom, prop turntable, or game level. The hero CRT remains the dominant motivated light. The room needs three depth planes, real architecture, foreground parallax, occupancy detail, coherent scale, localized wear, authored UVs, and source-motivated static indirect illumination. Amber remains the only chromatic accent.

## Non-negotiables
- Preserve the exact live glass plane and cold-open framing.
- Blender authors static physical geometry, UVs, materials, and bake sources; R3F retains CRT shader, terminal, camera, interaction, stage routing, and phosphor.
- No runtime downloads or post-processing used to cover weak modeling/lighting.
- No navigation-time allocations or shader compilation.
- Respect QUALITY.md geometry/texture/performance budgets.
- Keep existing uncommitted user changes intact.

## Done when
The Blender home scene has reviewed clay/material/final evidence, exports deterministically into local optimized assets, integrates without cold-open pixel changes, and passes the validated talk-quality workflow plus manual targeted-frame review.

name: Upgrade the hero CRT housing and materials
description: Keep the glass shader; remodel the housing/profile/controls/vents/stand/cable where needed and separate shell, bezel, stand, hardware material response within the QUALITY.md budget.
result: Rebuilt hero CRT CAD with five-station shell, stepped bezel seat, broader vents, mould/service seams, control well, articulated stand, rear collar, and cable gland. GLB is 15,716 triangles / 588,984 bytes and retains the exact 520x292mm screen contract. Added scene-side shell/front/stand material partitions plus existing separate controls/cable. Build/public hashes match; production build and Swamp reveal captures pass technically. Viewer: http://127.0.0.1:7373/?part=crt-monitor.

name: Complete photographic material and lighting lookdev
description: Create authored UVs and coherent materials for CRT plastic/faceplate surroundings, desk timber, walls, floor, fabric, metal, paper, and ceramic. Establish screen-led 3am lighting, doorway separation, negative fill, and static indirect response. Produce clay, material-neutral, and final reviewed renders.

name: Build repeatable home, cubicle, and agent-wall stages
description: Add slide-declared stage variants, inexpensive deterministic distant-agent screens, and occluded stage switching. Preserve hero monitor and one-press/one-slide navigation.
result: Added src/scene/Stages.jsx with slide-declared home/cubicle/wall contexts, bidirectional glass-occluded StageDirector swaps, six deterministic cubicle neighbors, and a 55-monitor wall (54 instanced procedural agents plus full-resolution hero) using one chassis and one screen draw.

name: Rebalance lighting and post-processing
description: Establish photographic exposure hierarchy, motivated doorway separation, restrained AO/bloom/vignette/CA/dither, and no cold-open tells.
result: Rebalanced Scene.jsx/environment.js and Effects.jsx: localized less-saturated screen spill, motivated doorway cue, lower AO/bloom/vignette/CA/saturation, and 0.34-LSB static dither. Cold-open zeros remain intact.

name: Add monitor manufacturing detail
description: Improve CAD render asset with vents, seams, control details, cable strain-relief cues, and export higher quality GLB without chasing printability warnings.
result: Added eight narrow CAD vent cuts per side, chin service seam/control recesses, dark internal vent baffles, and cable strain relief. Rebuilt and copied the 466KB GLB to public/models/crt-monitor.glb; updated the part card.

name: Replace game-era office rendering with a researched PBR pipeline
description: Fix chair/table intersections and scale, restore actual filmic tone mapping, use HDR image-based lighting and real PBR materials, improve modeled office silhouettes and grounding, evaluate path tracing suitability, and preserve deterministic cold-open/navigation behavior.
result: Research found progressive path tracing is a poor fit for continuously moving cameras, an animated terminal texture, and the instanced wall/phosphor architecture. Fixed the actual compositor bug by adding explicit ACES after EffectComposer's NoToneMapping override. Added a local CC0 HDR office PMREM, real CC0 linen/carpet PBR sets, VSM static shadow blur, neutral stage-aware screen spill, a modeled ceiling grid/air return/desk support, realistic 730mm office floor-to-desk scale, and clear chair placement. Rebuilt the CAD chair with casters, lift, armrests, reclined channeled back, and physical sheen material; moved chairs fully in front of desk edges. Removed the obsolete procedural surface module. Production build passes; direct-vs-navigation wall/inside state matches exactly; cold open remains pixel-flat. SwiftShader relative performance versus the pre-optimization baseline improved home ~74%, office ~23%, wall ~44%, and phosphor ~20%.

name: Refine hero assets and raise quality per frame
description: Correct monitor material/bezel/cable, remove repeating prop and keyboard textures, improve the terminal-to-tube choreography, add modeled office details, and reduce GPU/CPU load while preserving photographic quality and deterministic transitions.
result: Removed box-projected tiled normals from the CRT and desk props; restored indexed CAD geometry and material-specific broad roughness. Replaced the 13,404-triangle keycap with a 300-triangle tapered/dished render mesh (about 2.1M triangles removed across two 80-key keyboards). Added actual dark button inserts with a non-lighting status LED, routed the monitor cable over the rear desk edge and down out of sight, and retained the numerically matched 16.09x9.08 opening around the 16x9 screen. Reworked the tube wake into a staged 2.4s raster-then-curvature/glass/bezel choreography. Modeled and instanced CAD fluorescent troffers, filing pedestals, and task chairs for the office. Performance: DPR capped at 1.25; point cube-shadow removed; static 1024px spot shadows update only on stage swaps; four fixtures share two area lights; 2x scene MSAA replaced by FXAA; bloom is four half-resolution levels; full-screen terminal animation skips mipmap regeneration. SwiftShader benchmark improved reveal ~60%, cubicle ~30%, wall ~34%; direct-vs-navigation state remains exact; production build passes.

name: Replace the blockout aesthetic with corporate recursion
description:
Stop polishing isolated assets and redesign the composed world around ART-DIRECTION.md: complete room architecture, human-height long-lens cameras, motivated architectural lighting/static irradiance, spatially receding cubicle/wall infrastructure, and a physical phosphor coating instead of particle terrain. Approve targeted frames, not metrics or a continuous run.

Progress 2026-08-27: added ART-DIRECTION.md; replaced the home void with a complete room/hall/window envelope; rebuilt the office as a four-depth two-bank aisle; rebuilt the monitor wall as a concave rack vault; added per-slide 32–35° lens cues with frame-clock FOV animation and lower observational camera positions; neutralized the blue game-light palette; and replaced the 14-unit row-height phosphor terrain with depth-writing capsule grains in a deterministic oblique rest ribbon. Added a photographic-integration pass without concealment gimmicks: shared authored contact patches, material-level atmosphere, lower uniform fill/bloom/vignette, HPL/fabric microresponse, a corrected wall spill source, and a recessed hero backing. Home and cubicle now use deterministic offline-baked neutral/green irradiance plus floor-occlusion fields generated by scripts/bake-home-irradiance.py and scripts/bake-cubicle-irradiance.py. A material-wide PBR sampling prototype was rejected after it regressed the cubicle transition to 48–50ms p95; the production implementation projects those fields through three simplified receiver draws and passes the focused cubicle transition at 17.6ms p95, 49.9ms max, 47.6ms input latency, camera-continuity pass, and zero navigation programs/textures in run 20c6adc4-cf04-481c-b05d-4b533ee1ae37. Targeted 1920×1080 anchors are in d5c00c53-b1fd-4d2f-810e-cd691d508a37. Still requires Scott's targeted visual approval and presentation-hardware review.

name: Eliminate full terminal uploads for caret-only animation
description: Separate static transcript pixels from the blinking caret so settled screens do not upload and remipmap 2560x1440 at 1.9Hz. Prove with the transition harness.
result: Moved the blinking caret into CRT shader uniforms while keeping transcript pixels static. Settled transition traces now show zero terminal uploads and zero mipmap generations; previously they showed eight of each in four seconds. Cold-open caret still blinks and its on/off captures differ only around the caret. Also capped live-step paint keys at session progress so completed steps stop uploading.

name: Choreograph distinct reveal camera beats
description: Make frontal, angle, profile, reset, cubicle, and wall shots visually distinct and calmly paced.
result: Expanded src/slides/index.js to 11 real slides: tube wake, home front/30-degree/70-degree profile, glass thresholds, cubicle reveal/wide, and wall near/wide. Every press remains one slide.

name: Author the complete home office in Blender
description: Build the room envelope and lived-in contemporary home office around the existing hero monitor: architecture, desk, foreground obstruction, window/door depth, storage, shelving, cables, and restrained personal occupancy cues. Keep silhouettes and construction physically credible at the reveal and boundaries cameras.

name: Build deterministic Blender export pipeline
description: Add version-controlled bpy export tooling and documented conventions. Export optimized GLB and local baked textures with stable names, scale, origins, color spaces, material slots, and triangle/texture budgets. Source .blend files remain editable.

name: Build the declarative presentation authoring system
description: Support future slide-specific ideas without one-off scene hacks. Preserve one keypress=one slide, atomic displayStage, hidden bidirectional swaps, pre-mounted/prewarmed representations, zero navigation allocations, deterministic offline rendering, and cold-open flatness. Architecture: PRESENTATION-SYSTEM.md; terms: CONTEXT.md.

name: Remodel mouse and lamp; finish desktop props
description: Mouse: shell/base/buttons/wheel/recess/seam/contact within 6k tris. Lamp: hollow shade/interior/socket, paired arms, joints/fasteners, cable and base seams within 12k. Improve keyboard material separation and preserve instancing.
result: Rebuilt mouse (5,874 triangles, 65x112x39mm) and architect lamp (3,020 triangles, 150x335x354mm) as local GLBs with modeled construction seams, controls/joints, hollow shade, and cables. Added scene-side shell/base/wheel and lamp base/body/shade material partitions while preserving instancing. Production build passes; Swamp 1920x1080 reveal captures show both props readable in the home scene. Viewer renders: build/renders/mouse.png and build/renders/desk_lamp.png.

name: Upgrade CRT reveal, desk materials, and office lighting
description: Smooth the flat-terminal to physical-CRT wake, make home timber and cubicle laminate materially distinct, soften shadows, and give the cubicle stage bright overhead office lighting while preserving the flat cold open and deterministic stage swaps.
result: Replaced exponential CRT damping with a bounded smoothstep wake and extended it to 1.8s. Found the material root cause: every Nurb GLB lacked TEXCOORD_0, so all PBR maps sampled one texel. Added deterministic box-projected UVs to the monitor and CAD props and directional planar UVs to the walnut desk; verified all 20 mapped meshes now have UVs. Split home and cubicle furniture: home uses authored mahogany veneer, cubicle uses a separate rounded pale laminate worktop, carpet, woven acoustic panels, office props, and laminate neighbor desks. Added a prebuilt bright office PMREM, four fluorescent area fixtures, neutral hemisphere fill, office glass reflections, and a broad soft overhead shadow source. Reduced home point-shadow intensity and increased shadow softness. Direct-vs-navigated wall/inside state remains exact and Vite production build passes.

name: Choose the AA pipeline from measured A/B captures
description: Compare FXAA, 2x composer MSAA at DPR1.25, 4x MSAA at DPR1, and 2x+FXAA using identical captures/traces; select the lowest-cost candidate that passes Q1 and transition bars.
result: Implemented immutable ?quality&aa profiles and ran all required candidates plus a 2x-linear/4x-pixel supersampled reference through the Swamp talk-quality workflow. Added pinned ssim.js@3.5.0 Wang-style SSIM to compare-images. 2x MSAA at DPR1.25 was visually closest, but no candidate passed all SSIM>=0.99 crops; MSAA candidates also produced larger isolated headless frame spikes. Per the selection rule there is no qualifying winner, so production FXAA remains unchanged rather than choosing by reputation. Evidence: /tmp/aa-deterministic, /tmp/aa-perf; all navigation allocations stayed at zero.

name: Validate performance and visual acceptance
description: Run swamp workflow validate talk-quality and the production talk-quality workflow. Review reveal/boundaries/close stills, moving transitions, clay/light-only evidence, luminance anchors, intersections, allocations, and frame timing. Compare against the baseline and keep the Blender stage only if the pixels are clearly better.

name: Restore visible camera and lighting continuity
description:
Fix one-frame cuts caused by competing transition controllers, make post/lighting changes follow physical glass coverage instead of slide declarations, and review every adjacent transition forward, backward, and interrupted as frame strips. Do not close from settled screenshots or timing alone.

Progress 2026-08-26: reproduced cubicle-threshold→cubicle-reveal and wall-threshold→agent-wall-near as exact one-frame restores. Root cause was re-entrant Zustand runtime configuration followed by the navigation listener restoring the already-configured destination. CameraRig now has one render-clock owner. Post exposure/bloom/vignette/dither/ACES/FXAA now share a camera-derived flatness blend and the composer bypasses only after a settled covered frame. Full fallback Swamp run 057aa860-ca93-4b89-9dbd-9b2ebff6f9f7 reports cameraContinuity pass for all 28 adjacent directions, zero console/network errors, and 24/28 overall automation passes; four failures were isolated input-latency probes, not path cuts. Headed frame strips live in /tmp/transition-visual-after. User visual approval is pending.

name: Implement physical CRT glass and Trinitron mask
description: Use aperture grille for FW900-like display and add Fresnel-driven glass reflection, thickness cues, and deterministic smudge variation without compromising tube=0 passthrough.
result: Switched the FW900-like tube to aperture grille with two Nyquist-guarded damping wires. Replaced lit faceplate material with an unlit analytic-room reflection shader using physical Fresnel plus deterministic deposit roughness, avoiding the impossible self-light hotspot.

name: Make stage transitions atomic and presentation-ready
description: Create a presentation-ready gate, warm each actual stage/post/shadow variant, introduce one displayStage authority for geometry/environment/lights/effects/shadows, move shadow invalidation after visibility commit, and drive camera/CRT/phosphor/stage gates from one frame clock without changing navigation semantics.
result: Implemented atomic displayStage, bidirectional occlusion micro-legs for early presses, frame-clock camera settlement, post/stage/default-framebuffer/shadow/material/texture warming, production ?quality diagnostics, and post-commit shadow lifecycle. A 1920x1080 warm run covered all 28 adjacent directions with zero new programs/textures/uploads except expected live terminal transcript updates; 26/28 passed in the fleet run and both isolated outliers passed 3/3 immediate repeats. Cubicle context swaps pass with zero allocation/upload and 17.6-18.6ms p95. Projector hardware remains the final acceptance environment.

name: Replace the task chair and upgrade office framing
description:
Replace the weak task chair and pedestal, fix all clearances, eliminate cubicle-wide black void, reduce linen moire, and meet office composition/material/contact captures.

Progress 2026-08-26: user-approved original 29,164-triangle chair and 7,792-triangle box/box/file pedestal are integrated with instanced material groups. The office now uses shared layout presets, full-height framed panels, aligned background worktops/supports, one showcase chair, and measured clearances (~31mm chair-panel, 28.6mm hero pedestal-desk, 30.3mm background pedestal). Cameras were reframed and the black set edge is gone. Headed focused run 50d182d6-6a2a-4ecd-87c0-c9f60a3ffabd and integrated run 57f0a533-b7fd-425e-a40d-25f9725d813a pass technically. Still open for user/projector framing and moving-path contact approval.

name: Verify build, runtime, screenshots, and navigation
description: Run direct Vite build, capture representative stage screenshots, inspect console, and verify each keypress remains exactly one slide forward/back.
result: Direct Vite production build passes (728 modules). Headless WebGL screenshots verified home, cubicle, wall, and profile with no runtime/shader errors. Keyboard walk recorded indexes 0..10 then exact reverse 9..0; session step remained 0 on arrow navigation.

name: Add semantic survey visuals and resident render targets
description: When Scott supplies individual slide ideas, define survey values once in a closed visual catalog, render the same semantics in terminal/?flat, and precompile resident phosphor targets before readiness.

name: Pass the visual quality bars
description: Bring aliasing, transitions, assets, materials, lighting, composition, and phosphor handoff to the measurable acceptance gates in QUALITY.md. No task is complete because a setting changed; each needs the required captures/traces.

name: Prototype the shader-to-phosphor geometry handoff
description: Implement the next payoff promised in PLAN.md: push from the 55-monitor wall back into the hero glass, match the widened aperture-grille pitch with instanced phosphor geometry sampling the live terminal texture, cross the screen plane, and release cells into deterministic depth. Preserve cold-open, offline, Nyquist, and one-slide-per-press rules.
result: Added PhosphorField.jsx with 34,560 instanced live-texture deposits matching a 120-triad/360-stripe aperture grille at maskPitchPx 32. Added wall-return, approach, threshold, and inside-glass slides; hero/set removal remains bidirectionally occluded by StageDirector. At the plane cells crossfade at matched pitch, then deterministic depth offsets create the interior lattice. Build passes, screenshots for all three phases show no runtime errors, and arrow navigation now walks 0..14 and exact reverse with session step unchanged.
